warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).

Widths: where two widths are printed (1.00/0.90, 0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70) the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m). Heights measured from ระดับพื้นห้อง; door and window heads at 2.05.
ป1 and น1 carry a 0.45 fixed transom above the 2.05 head (top at 2.50) — kept in transom_note, not added into height_m.
